title: Function-preserving SERV area optimization
claims: The workflow receives a content-addressed SERV RTL baseline and an independently worded function-preserving area-optimization contract.
Functional and cycle-visible equivalence are mandatory gates before any QoR metric can be considered.
excluded_claims: Compliance programs, evaluator traces, PPA scripts, cell libraries, optimized human or alternate solutions, and hidden thresholds are not public inputs.
The visible runner, hidden evaluator, PPA environment, scoring profile, public digest, and independent admission are not frozen.

Development structural checks and one public four-instruction smoke are not hidden F2P/P2P, ISA compliance, physical area, timing, power, performance, QoR-gain, workflow, score, benchmark-readiness, or ChipFlow-adapter-readiness claims.
